function.arguments: {"index": 2, "status": "acted", "resolution": "The `patient_id` column has 48 duplicate values, meaning 48 patients were re-tested and appear in two rows each. According to the data dictionary, the row with the highest `sample_seq` supersedes earlier rows for that patient. Therefore, to ensure one row per patient in the treatment arm, we must deduplicate on `patient_id` by keeping the row with the maximum `sample_seq` for each patient. This is essential to avoid double-counting patients in the denominator of the response fraction. We will perform this deduplication before computing the fraction of responders in the treatment arm."}
function.name: resolve_finding
